_NOTE_secrets: Do NOT commit config.json. Prefer setting secrets as environment variables (HL_GEMINI_API_KEY, HL_PEXELS_API_KEY, HL_PIXABAY_API_KEY, HL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL, HL_ELEVENLABS_API_KEYS) so keys never live in a file. See README.
_NOTE_quality: Three quality gates: absolute_quality_floor (hard reject below) < quality_floor < min_quality (target). Lower min_quality if too many slots are sacrificed.
_NOTE_score_broll: score_broll=true uses Gemini to rank b-roll for relevance (esp. the first frame). Set false to save Gemini quota.
_NOTE_cadence: For a channel under ~100k subs, 1-3 high-quality shorts/day beats 5 average ones: posting too many/day splits YouTube's per-video testing so fewer get picked up. Raise videos_per_day only once your average per-video views are climbing.
_NOTE_publish_slots: Set these to when YOUR audience is active (Studio > Analytics > Audience > 'When your viewers are on YouTube'), usually evening ~6-9pm. Posting into your active window means YouTube first shows it to your people, who don't swipe = a clean early signal. See ALGORITHM_AND_DISTRIBUTION.md.
